automatedRemovalReason.label: Automated removal reason
automatedRemovalReason.helpText: Title of removal reason to add when removing content. Leave blank to skip adding a removal reason.

messageDelivery.label: Notification delivery method
messageDelivery.helpText:
Delivery method for notifications issued to Redditors. If not selected, all notification messages will be suppressed.
This setting only affects public notifications. Outputs initiated from user-facing menu actions will always be issued as PMs.

keywordVoteKeywords.label: Keyword vote triggers
keywordVoteKeywords.helpText: Use one !keyword per line or comma-separated. Maximum 10 keywords.

bannedWordsList.label: Banned words and phrases
bannedWordsList.helpText: Use one word/phrase per line or comma-separated.

weeklyMegathreadBody.label: Weekly megathread body
weeklyMegathreadBody.defaultValue:
Welcome to this week's TV discussion thread.

Please keep spoilers hidden using Reddit spoiler syntax: `>!spoiler text!<` (example: >!the ending reveal!<).

Share your theories, reactions, and favorite moments below.

postFlairLock.label: Post flair locking
postFlairLock.helpText: These settings are for the post flair locking system.

postFlairLock_enableProtectedFlairs.label: Enable protected flairs
postFlairLock_enableProtectedFlairs.helpText: If disabled, manually-set flair locks will still operate.

postFlairLock_protectedFlairList.label: Protected flairs
postFlairLock_protectedFlairList.helpText: Enter a list of post flair template UUIDs, separated by line breaks.

postFlairLock_protectedEmptyFlair.label: Protect empty flair
postFlairLock_protectedEmptyFlair.helpText: Whether to consider no flair as protected.

postFlairLock_notifyOnProtectedChange.label: Send notifications when attempting to change from a protected flair
postFlairLock_notifyOnProtectedChange.helpText: Turn off to make flair reversions for protected flairs operate silently, with no notification.

postFlairLock_sendGraceWarning.label: Send grace period notifications
postFlairLock_sendGraceWarning.helpText: Turn off to make grace periods operate silently, with no notification.

postFlairLock_graceMinutes.label: Grace period length (min)
postFlairLock_graceMinutes.helpText: Length of grace period when changing to a protected post flair. Supports decimal values.

postFlairLock_messageCooldown.label: Message cooldown (min)
postFlairLock_messageCooldown.helpText: Number of minutes to not send duplicate messages. Supports decimal values.

flairLabels.label: User flair labels
flairLabels.helpText: Enter a list of user flair tempalate IDs. These will appear in the user flair selection menu.

upgradeThresholds.label: Upgrade thresholds
upgradeThresholds.helpText: Enter a list of space-separated numbers in ascending order. This setting defines the number of upgrade levels and the amount of karma that must be earned for each level.

upgradeSymbol.label: Upgrade symbol
upgradeSymbol.helpText: Enter text that will be repeated once for each level of user flair ugprades.
